plugins.name: bishop
plugins.description: A recurring job search that runs itself, and interview prep for the roles it finds. A setup interview writes your profile and scoring rubric, then a scheduled task sources, verifies, scores, and ranks roles into a digest you actually read. Interview practice builds decks you drill out loud, one per company, tailored to its interviews. The outreach board sorts your LinkedIn connections into groups worth contacting and tracks who you've reached out to, on your own computer. Includes an optional private web dashboard. Works at any career level.
